dedupe_keys.name: ideal household energy dataset 255 uk homes

description: The IDEAL Household Energy Dataset covers 255 UK homes monitored by the University of Edinburgh. For every home it holds electricity and gas data, temperature and humidity readings for individual rooms, and boiler temperature readings; for 39 homes there are more detailed data on individual appliance use and individual radiators. Sensor data are joined by anonymised surveys and metadata on occupant demographics, self-reported energy awareness and attitudes, and building, room and appliance characteristics, with documentation and coding files. Coverage: 255 homes in the United Kingdom. Access: zipped files on Edinburgh DataShare, about 30 GB in total, with a README; the dataset is described in a Scientific Data paper. Licence: DataShare end-user licence; free. Caveats: the DataShare record lists a replacing version, so users should check for the latest release, and the sample is not statistically representative. Simulation uses are occupant-linked heating and electricity demand models, room-level thermal model calibration and behaviour studies. Related records: UK-DALE and the Low Carbon London smart meter data.
